timeline.body:
We are currently fetching fields added by the fields API by name which breaks support for wildcards. More over, in case wildcards are used and those wildcards matches the geo field, then a ClassCastException is thrown.

This commit changes the strategy on how those fields are fetched by just iterating over the returned map. In addition, the geo field is added the last one on the fields list so it does not get overridden.

fixes  https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/85592

timeline.body: I guess args definition could have moved down too since it is only used by the code that was moved down.
I presume this means that the last fetch field that matches dominates?

reply.body: Yes, it populates a map so if it finds the same name it gets written over. If the behaviour changes, test should notice it.

timeline.body: I presume `searchHits.getFields()` contains the subset of `request.getFieldAndFormats()` that was actually found? So this way we skip fields not found?

reply.body: I added a test for a non-existing field and for a field with null value. Everything seems to behave as expected

timeline.body: I presume this defensive coding it not really required because the fix in RestVectorTileAction should already remove the nulls? Do we have this code in case there are other code paths we've not thought of that might cause nulls? Would it make more sense to throw an error here so we don't hide bugs?

reply.body: I removed the defensive coding. I added more test and it seems we are never passing null values here.

timeline.body: It looks good, but I did have a few clarifying questions.
